title: ctenitis exculta
intro: Ctenitis exculta, commonly known as the 'excult fern', is a type of plant that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Ctenitis exculta are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
